description:
BattleCore

The Ultimate Military Survival, PvP & Territory Warfare Experience

BattleCore is a next-generation Minecraft server that combines military combat, survival, economy, clan warfare and territory conquest into one persistent world. Every decision matters, every resource has value, and every battle can change the balance of power.

Unlike traditional PvP servers where players simply fight and respawn, BattleCore creates a living world where players build their reputation, strengthen their clan, control land, and compete for long-term dominance.

A Persistent World

Nothing is temporary.

Everything you accomplish contributes to your long-term progression.

Players develop their character through exploration, combat, missions, loot collection, economy management and territorial expansion.

Your progress is always meaningful.

Military Weapon System

BattleCore introduces an advanced military weapon system featuring custom 3D models.

Available weapon categories include:

• Assault Rifles

• Submachine Guns

• Pistols

• Sniper Rifles

• Shotguns

• Combat Knives

• Grenades

Each weapon has its own:

Damage

Fire rate

Effective range

Recoil

Reload speed

Ammunition type

Sound effects

3D model

Bedrock and Java compatibility

Weapons use real ammunition.

Running out of ammo during combat can cost you the fight.

Ammunition System

Every weapon requires its own ammunition.

Examples:

• Pistol Ammo

• Rifle Ammo

• SMG Ammo

• Shotgun Shells

• Sniper Ammo

• Grenades

Ammo must be purchased, looted or earned through gameplay.

This creates a true survival experience where resource management is just as important as combat skill.

Dynamic Loot System

The world constantly generates loot chests around active players.

Loot contains:

• Food

• Resources

• Vanilla tools

• Building materials

• Money resources

• Diamonds

• Rare supplies

• Weapon ammunition

• Special equipment

Each loot table is fully configurable.
